newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS - Straddle bought in Asda Group.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - Straddle bought in Asda Group.

text.p: Stock options trading proceeded quiet on Monday reflecting the cautious mood of the stock market, dealers said.
The biggest trade by early afternoon was a long straddle in supermarket chain Asda Group which was established by buying 250 July 110 calls and puts at 15p and 3p each.
The deal will make a profit if the underlying shares go far enough in either direction. To be in the money by expiry, the shares need to either go below 92p or above 128p.
By 1350 GMT, Asda shares had lost a penny to 120-1/2p while the FTSE 100 index was up a mere 1.4 points at 4,220.2.
